chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad from Mu'alla ibn Muhammad from al-Wassha' from al-Mufaddal ibn Salih from Jabir from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said:
I asked him about the young children when they line up in the obligatory prayer. He said, 'Do not delay them from the prayer, and separate them from one another.'
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on young children participating in congregational prayer?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Imam al-Baqir (AS) instructs that young children should not be delayed from joining the obligatory congregational prayer, emphasizing the importance of early habituation (*ta'dib*) to worship. The directive to separate them (*farriqo baynahum*) serves to maintain congregational order and prevent distraction, reflecting the Shia scholarly view that prayer is a communal duty instilled from childhood. This ruling underscores the practical application of nurturing religious discipline within the family and community structure.
